Two warts: the comment `// a page below the first is read as the first page` restates `Math.max`, and the new requirement id `REQ-OWNERSPAGEPARAM-001` breaks the `REQ-OWN-00n` vocabulary. Docs: PRD requirement, done-when, edge cases, open questions, and the system-design contract row and invariant note all move; no visible stale claim.
